2026: H1 Recap

More data, more coverage, more markets.

Dear Valued Customer,

 

The first half of 2026 has been a milestone period for Green Street. We welcomed StorTrack and Insight Investment Research to the Green Street family and launched Green Street Infrastructure, adding coverage across 10 infrastructure sectors, including 21 Transport companies, advancing our mission to empower the global real assets industry.


Behind the scenes, we strengthened the commercial real estate data and analytics you rely on every day, initiating coverage on 14 companies across Data Centers, Diversified, Industrial, Lodging, Net Lease and Retail sectors in Australia, Europe, and the U.S., continuing to expand the breadth and depth you need.


Below is a recap of the key reports, product updates, and news you may have missed, plus a look at what's ahead in H2.

 

Your Green Street Team
